workflow.name: Documentation pass
workflow.description: Reads the code, finds what the docs get wrong, and rewrites them. No CI, since nothing executable changes.

skills.name: audit-the-docs
skills.description: Compares documentation against the code and reports the real gaps.
skills.skill_md_content:
---
name: audit-the-docs
description: Compares documentation against the code and reports the real gaps.
---

Work out what the documentation currently gets wrong.

Subject: ${task_title}

${task_body}

Read the code and the existing docs side by side. Note what is missing, what
is stale, and what is simply wrong. Prefer a few real gaps over a long list of
nitpicks.

Write your findings into an output block named `findings`.

skills.name: write-the-docs
skills.description: Rewrites documentation from an audit, for a reader who is new to the code.
skills.skill_md_content:
---
name: write-the-docs
description: Rewrites documentation from an audit, for a reader who is new to the code.
---

Update the documentation based on these findings:

${findings}

Write for somebody who has not seen this code before. Show the shortest thing
that works before the exhaustive reference. Do not document what the code does
not do.
